candidate_time.unit_note: Segment rows are descriptive; label effects use one aggregate row per affected video.

conclusions.after_source_and_shot_control: source_group×shot_type 內的 overlap-weighted 差異仍存在（mean 0.93、affected risk 12.29 個百分點），但較未調整差異縮小；這是描述性調整，不是因果估計。
conclusions.candidate_label_descriptive_association: 有清楚的描述性關聯：Make 的 mean candidate ratio 高 1.24 個百分點、affected rate 高 15.53 個百分點，Cliff’s delta=0.162；rank effect 偏小，且 source-cluster CI 必須一併解讀。
conclusions.candidate_rear_concentration: candidate segments 後段占比高於前段；需連同 source/shot/FPS 分層解讀。
conclusions.next_round: 維持 v3.1 進入可觀測、train-only DataLoader 整合；另做 z=-2.5 derived sensitivity，並以人工標註校準 candidate 的語義。
conclusions.sampler_label_position_shift: epoch 0 有小幅前移（Make−Miss selected-center=-0.0116，95% CI [-0.0187, -0.0041]）；20 個 deterministic epochs 的 quality-aware 差異範圍為 [-0.0117, 0.0046]，相對 unrestricted baseline 的平均 difference-in-differences=-0.0043。三項檢查均在 ±0.05 警示尺度內，未見實質 label 位移。

limitations: All associations are descriptive and do not identify causal effects.
Candidate means low local Laplacian under v3.1, not human-confirmed blur.
The centered scanner is offline/full-video and cannot support a pre-release prediction claim.
Segment-level summaries contain correlated segments; inferential label effects use affected-video aggregates.
Only source-group holdout is established; game-level holdout is not confirmed.
No video-content near-duplicate scan was performed in this audit.
No validation/test video or quality metadata was analyzed.
The multi-epoch counterfactual is a deterministic sensitivity sweep, not independent-sample inference.

multi_epoch_counterfactual.method: same video/seed/epoch/hash sampler; unrestricted baseline supplies no candidate segments; deterministic epoch sensitivity, not independent-sample inference

sampler.selection_source: validated existing derived CSV or byte-identical metadata-only epoch=0 reconstruction
